# Itay Lisaey

> Co-Founder and CTO of Novana, based in Tokyo, Japan. Engineer and technical
> leader working on AI-native products, LLM-powered systems, and the cloud
> infrastructure behind them.

This is the personal site of Itay Lisaey (https://itay.lisaey.com). It is a

## Current work

- [Pragmatican](https://pragmatican.com): Takes on select consulting projects

## Background
